en: At last, Bahamut was reeled in!{w}
note: Source has no subject. Benef holds the rod and the party weakened the fish, so the passive keeps it open.

en: "I did it! I did iiiit!!"{w}
When the long battle was over, a gigantic fish lay before you.{w}
"It's huuuge, nya!!"{w}
note: Muse's verbal tic: nya = nya, nyan = nyan. Not yet set by another slice; harmonize with slice_021.

en: "How about that, Muse!{w}Think you can steal THIS one from me and swallow it whole!?"{w}
"Wahahaha! You can't, can you!?{w}Eat it if you can!!"{w}
"...I'm allowed, nya?"{w}
note: Muse is checking that Benef really means she may eat it (next rows confirm).

en: "Hahaha... Huh?"{w}
"I can really eat it, nya?"{w}{p}"Then Muse is going all out too...{w}Unyunyunyunyuuu~~"{w}
note: Muse refers to herself as Muse (third person); kept.

en: "D-don't tell me you're...!?"{w}
"Suuuper... MYUUUUU!!"{w}
"Wh-what is this light!?{w}Gwaaaaah!?"{w}
Super Muse
"Nya!!"{w}
"Whoooaaa!?"{w}

"FUHAHAHA!
I HUNGER, YOU FOOLS!!"{w}{p}"ALL THOSE YEARS OF HOLDING BACK MY HUNGRY SPIRIT HAVE PAID OFF!"{w}{p}"I, THE GREAT SUPER MUSE, SHALL DEVOUR THE WORLD AND ALL IN IT!{w}I SHALL BEGIN WITH THAT LITTLE FISHY THERE!"{w}
note: Super Muse speaks in all-hiragana with spaced phrases (old 8-bit RPG boss text); rendered in ALL CAPS. hungry seishin (drive) is punned with literal hunger: 'hungry spirit'. 'Little fishy' = kozakana, i.e. Bahamut.

en: "CHOMP!"{w}
note: All caps for Super Muse, as above.

en: "Ba... Bahamut...{w}My rival..."{w}
"MUNCH MUNCH... WHAT IS THIS!?{w}THAT BITE ONLY THE WILD-CAUGHT KIND HAS..."{w}{p}"FIRM FLESH WITH A PLUMP, SPRINGY TEXTURE!?{w}NYAHAAAAAAAAUUU!?"{w}
"MY HUNGRY SPIRIT...{w}IS BEING SATISFIEEED?{w}CURSE YOOOU..."{w}
"Mmm, so satisfied, nyaaa. ...Flop.{w}Zzz... zzz..."{w}
Muse deftly spat out nothing but the bones, then flopped back down as usual.{w}
"Th-there's nothing left but bones, picked clean!!"{w}
The soundly sleeping girl's face showed not even a trace of the outrageous events of moments ago.{w}
"Hmm.{w}Now I've no way to prove I caught it, but please, at least take these bones with you."{w}{p}"Muse... what a fearsome one..."{w}
You found something in Bahamut's bones.{w}
"Mnya mnya~"{w}
note: munyamunya (sleep mumbling) rendered with Muse's cat sound.

en: A Werebeast girl is sleeping.{w}
"I'm so hungryyy, nyaaa~~~..."{w}
Grrrrumble~~~ gurrrgle~~~{w}{p}You thought it was the ship creaking, but it was coming from the girl's stomach.{w}
"Mmm... *yawn*.{w}My tummy was so empty it woke me up, nyan.{w}Huh, who are you, nya?"{w}
Grrrrumble~~~ gurrrgle~~~{w}
"Ugh, my tummy is screaming, nya!{w}Everyone, save Muse's tummy, nya!{w}Or else something terrible will happen to the land, nya!!"{w}
note: 'Everyone' (minna) = the party.

en: "What will save Muse's tummy is...{w}...a Toryoron Potato, nya!"{w}{p}"They grow in the Dekor Ruins, so go and get one, nya!"{w}
note: Toryoron Potato and Dekor Ruins per glossary notes.

en: "I'm counting on you, nya~"{w}
"Zzz... zzz...{w}Dekor Ruins...{w}Toryoron Potato..."{w}
You called out to her, but she showed no sign of waking up at all.{w}
When you took out the Toryoron Potato, Muse woke up.{w}

"That's a Toryoron Potato, nya!{w}You got it for me, nyan!? You're useful, nya!{w}I'll make you Muse's underlings, nya!"{w}{p}"Chomp... munch munch...{w}Mmm! It's all toryo-ey and yummy!{w}Yum-nyan-nyan~"{w}
note: kobun = underlings (rank 1). 'toryo~tto shite' puns on the potato's name: 'toryo-ey'. umanyannyan = 'Yum-nyan-nyan'.

en: "Ahh, so full, so fu... ll?"{w}
note: manzoku manzo...ku: the word breaks off as her hunger returns.

en: "Ugh, my tummy is screaming again, nya!{w}Everyone, save Muse's tummy, nya!!"{w}{p}"What will save Muse's tummy is...{w}...a Sun Melon, nya!"{w}{p}"They grow in the Blanc Desert, so go and get one, nya!"{w}
note: Taiyou no uri = Sun Melon (uri: gourd/melon).

en: "I'm counting on you, nya~{w}Muse will sleep here while she waits, nya...{w}Zzz... zzz..."{w}
"Zzz... zzz...{w}Blanc Desert...{w}Sun Melon..."{w}
You called out to your boss, but she showed no sign of waking up at all.{w}
note: oyabun: Muse, who had just made you her underlings.

en: When you took out the Sun Melon, Muse woke up.{w}

"That's a Sun Melon, nya!{w}You got it for me, nyan!? You're useful, nya!{w}I'll make you Muse's boss, nya!"{w}{p}"Chomp... munch munch...{w}Mmm! It smells like sunshine, and it's yummy!{w}Yum-nyan-nyan~"{w}
note: oyabun = boss (rank 2).

en: "Ugh, my tummy is screaming again, nya!{w}Everyone, save Muse's tummy, nya!!"{w}{p}"What will save Muse's tummy is...{w}...a Heerdahl Manju, nya!"{w}{p}"They sell them at the Heerdahl hot springs, so go and buy one, nya!"{w}
note: Manju follows the glossary 'Manju Seller'.

en: "Zzz... zzz...{w}Heerdahl...{w}Manju..."{w}
You called out to your underling, but she showed no sign of waking up at all.{w}
note: kobun: roles swapped, Muse is now your underling.

en: When you took out the Heerdahl Manju, Muse woke up.{w}

"That's a Heerdahl Manju, nya!{w}You got it for me, nyan!? You're useful, nya!{w}I'll make you Muse's master, nya!"{w}{p}"Chomp... munch munch...{w}Mmm! It's packed with red bean paste, yummy!{w}Yum-nyan-nyan~"{w}
note: goshujin-sama = master (rank 3).

en: "Ahh, so full, so full!{w}But to finish off, I really want some dessert, nyan."{w}{p}"The perfect dessert for Muse is...{w}...Shirinmorin's Leg, nya!"{w}{p}"I want you to go to the Narmant Trench, where Shirinmorin lives, and bring back Shirinmorin's Leg, nya!"{w}
note: Shirinmorin is the Water Sage (glossary). ashi = 'Leg' kept literal; it is eaten still wriggling (5066), so it may be a tentacle.

en: "Zzz... zzz...{w}Narmant...{w}Shirinmorin's Leg..."{w}
You called out to her as her master, but she showed no sign of waking up at all.{w}
When you took out Shirinmorin's Leg, Muse woke up.{w}

"That's Shirinmorin's Leg, nya!{w}You got it for me, nyan!? You're useful, nya!{w}I probably love you, nya!"{w}{p}"Chomp... munch munch...{w}Mmm! It's still moving, nya! Eating it alive, nya!!{w}Yum-nyan-nyan~"{w}
note: tabun aishiteru: the hedge 'probably' is the joke; kept. odorigui = eating it while it still moves.

en: "I'm satisfied, nya.{w}As thanks, Muse will teach you her special move, nya!"{w}{p}"But this move... puts a curse of hunger on you when you equip it, nya.{w}Use it when there's nothing else you can do, nyan!"{w}
note: harapeko no noroi = 'curse of hunger'; may be a game status name, so check against the item/skill text.

en: "Muse's tummy is full of hungry, nya!{w}If it goes on a rampage, it'll be a disaster, nya!{w}Well done, nyan!!"{w}
note: Context of this line is unclear (possibly the move's flavor text or a later idle line). 'full of hungry' keeps the hungry pun.

en: Bilente
"Welcome. My name is Bilente."{w}{p}"As you can see, I stock nothing but junk, but I do hope you'll favor me with your custom... Heh heh."{w}
note: fufu rendered as 'Heh heh' throughout for Bilente.

en: "I have a fondness for mysterious things... particularly antiques and toys with a dark history."{w}{p}"To start from the rumors surrounding old furnishings and toys, and let one's thoughts drift to the human hearts hidden behind them -- that is romance of the grandest kind, you see."{w}{p}"And collecting them on the side while running the shop, I ended up like this..."{w}{p}"Since I spend my entire fortune on my hobby, even my wife has run out of patience with me... Heh heh."{w}
note: kanai = 'my wife' (the word itself means one's own wife). Bilente's gender is not stated otherwise; no pronoun used for Bilente.

en: "When you're surrounded by so much mysterious junk like this, now and then you sense a will in some of it."{w}{p}"Take this bizarre carving of an old man, for example.{w}It sells now and then, but after a while it slips back in among the goods I've bought in."{w}{p}"On nights like that, it stands by my pillow and stares at me, you know."{w}{p}"It must be awfully fond of me. It needn't hold me frozen with sleep paralysis -- I'm not going to run away... Heh heh."{w}
note: kanashibari = being held paralyzed (sleep paralysis).

en: "This is an item I bought in the other day, called the Beldoll. It's what you'd call a puzzle ring."{w}{p}"Naturally, since I'm the one who acquired it, it's no ordinary puzzle ring."{w}{p}"They say that if you thread all the rings of the solved puzzle onto this key, something mysterious will happen."{w}{p}"I simply can't resist the mysterious.{w}But I've been at it these past few days, and I'm nowhere near solving it."{w}{p}"Part of me wants to solve it myself, but my wish to see the Beldoll's mystery wins out..."{w}{p}"So I've been thinking I might entrust it to someone who travels the world, have all sorts of people try their hand at it, and see it solved."{w}{p}"I wonder if there's anyone out there I could entrust it to... Heh heh."{w}
note: Beldoll per glossary (the ring and its spirit). chie no wa = puzzle ring.

en: Will you volunteer?
"Well, it is only a toy, after all.{w}If it were something a little more valuable, I'm sure someone would take it on."{w}

"Oh? You'll take it on, you say?"{w}{p}"Hmm... But you see.{w}This is, in its own way, a 'puzzle ring.'{w}I'd like to entrust it to someone worthy of it."{w}{p}"If you take on the Beldoll and manage to advance it one stage, I'll leave it with you."{w}{p}"Mind you, though it's called a puzzle ring, in truth it takes not just wits but a fair share of luck as well.{w}Now then, who will make the attempt?"{w}
note: The Japanese 'chie no wa' literally means 'ring of wisdom'; the wits/worthy link is carried by 'wits' in the last page rather than by the name.

en: Who will make the attempt?
"Then, please, go ahead... Heh heh."{w}
You were handed Beldoll +6.{w}

{0E}{10:0003:000F} is
working on it...{0F}{w}
note: Kept the source line break so the four attempt rows line up.

en: "Oh, splendid! You've advanced it one move!!"{w}
{0E}    *  The Beldoll changed to +5!!  *    {0F}{w}
note: Banner spacing follows the earlier '*  ...  *' banners.

en: "With this, I think I can safely entrust it to you all.{w}Please keep it with you as you travel the world."{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained Beldoll +5.{w}
"I'll keep the key myself, so once it's fully solved, please bring it to me.{w}I'll be looking forward to it."{w}
In the end, the Beldoll stayed just as it was.{w}
"...It seems that was no good.{w}Well, I'll look elsewhere, so please don't let it trouble you... Heh heh."{w}
